name: Pipedrive
one_liner: Pipedrive offers a RESTful CRM API with extensive endpoints, OAuth2 and API key authentication, webhooks, SDKs, and official MCP support for AI assistants.
auth_notes: Pipedrive accepts both API tokens and OAuth 2.0 access tokens for authentication.
access_notes: An API token is available with every plan, allowing free self‑serve access.

extras.rate_limits: Token‑based rate limiting with a daily budget and burst limits per plan.

evidence.snippet: Pipedrive MCP (Model Context Protocol) connects your AI assistant directly to Pipedrive
- (optional) a Developer Sandbox account (you don't need to have one, but you can create it if you're interested in building an app with Pipedrive or need an environment just for testing)
